text: Peicho Peev (Bulgarian: Пейчо Пеев; 2 April 1940 – 15 September 2007) was a Bulgarian chess International Master awarded in 1973. He won the Bulgarian Chess Championship in 1968 and earned a silver medal in the same tournament in 1971. Peev also secured multiple international chess tournament awards. He represented Bulgaria in the Chess Olympiads, the European Team Chess Championship, the World Student Team Chess Championship, and the Men's Chess Balkaniads. During his career, he was one of the leading Bulgarian chess players in the 1960s and 1970s. For many years, he worked as a chess coach for children and young people at the native Plovdiv chess club ШК Локомотив. This biographical article relating to a Bulgarian chess figure is a stub.
